_about: George Hutcheson (1615-1674), minister of Edinburgh and Irvine, one of the Scottish commentators of the 1650s: A Brief Exposition on the XII Small Prophets (London, 1657) and Forty-Five Sermons upon the CXXX Psalm (Edinburgh, 1691), both from EEBO microfilm scans set in long-s type; the OCR prints the long s as 'ſ', so the name check takes 'Hutcheſon' as well. His Exposition of John (1657) and of Job (1669) have no scan on IA except a 1971 reprint. CCEL and Gutenberg hold none of it. Internet Archive OCR, raw and unconverted; each title page read before listing.

hutcheson-small-prophets-1657: A Brief Exposition on the XII Small Prophets (London, 1657; EEBO scan)
hutcheson-psalm-130-sermons-1691: Forty-Five Sermons upon the CXXX Psalm (Edinburgh, 1691; EEBO scan)

_alternates.bim_early-english-books-1641-1700_a-brie: The first parts (Haggai, Zechariah, Malachi; Obadiah to Zephaniah), 1654, gathered into the 1657 volume.
